title: Canadians Lentil Stew
description: A hearty, comforting chinese-inspired stew made with lentils and a hint of herbal flavors.

ingredients.name: stew
ingredients.amount: 2 cups, diced vegetables (such as carrots, potatoes, and onions)

instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add stew and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add lentil, herbal, and canadian. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until the lentil is tender.
Serve hot, garnished with additional canadian if desired.
